description: 室内设计效果图、建筑外观渲染

presets.render_quality: Unreal Engine 5 style, hyper-realistic, ray tracing

pitfalls: 建筑图最容易透视变形，用'Eye-level perspective'压住
冷暖对比是作弊码：室外冷蓝+室内暖黄
材质要具体（混凝土/木地板/大理石/金属），不能只说'现代材质'
时间/天气要指定（白天/黄昏/夜景），不同时间氛围差异巨大

space.materials: Exposed concrete, large floor-to-ceiling glass, warm timber accents

filled.environment: Nestled in a dense, snowy pine forest visible through the glass

camera.lighting: Golden hour, warm interior lights glowing, cool blue ambient light outside

filled.render_quality: Unreal Engine 5 style, hyper-realistic, ray tracing
